description: Shows one of `loading`, `empty`, `error` or `success` for a data source. Bind `status` to `data.<source>.status` and `empty` to a test of `data.<source>.value`; the subtree reads the source as `data.<source>`.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading, error or ready; bind it to `data.<source>.status`.

props.name: isEmpty
props.description: The source has no content; shows the `empty` slot while ready.

slots.name: success
slots.description: Shown when the source is ready and not empty.
